title: Marvelous Designer’s YouTube Community Expands to Vietnam
content:
![5eb12f41db7c491882b036ae0ef39acf](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/6904063703fe43f7b111a50060fd629e/images/5eb12f41db7c491882b036ae0ef39acfMD%20VN%20YT%20English%2BViet%20Promo.png)

One year ago, we opened our office in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Since then, our presence across Southeast Asia has continued to grow, alongside our local team and partnerships. As part of our commitment to the region, we’re excited to launch a new YouTube channel dedicated to our Vietnamese Marvelous Designer community.  
  
The channel will feature Marvelous Designer news, updates, and tutorials translated and dubbed in Vietnamese. It will also include original content, including features on traditional Vietnamese garments.  
  
We’re continuing to invest in Southeast Asia, and this time Vietnam in particular, by supporting local creators and building resources that are accessible, relevant, and long-term. This new channel is one more way we’re extending that work alongside Marvelous Designer users in the region.  
  
Subscribe to Marvelous Designer Vietnam: [HERE](https://www.youtube.com/@MarvelousDesignerVi%E1%BB%87tNam)
content_description: Discover our new YouTube channel dedicated to the Vietnamese Marvelous Designer community, offering localized news, tutorials, and features that celebrate both the platform and traditional Vietnamese garments.

title: MDCC Vol3 1st Place: Moon Face Animation crafting Steampunk Realities
content:
## _Meet Moet, the visionary behind Moon Face Animation._

## _With two decades of experience spanning the entertainment and advertising industries in both Tokyo and Montpellier, Moet bridges the gap between traditional aesthetics and modern 3D technology._

## _Moet discusses her approach on her_[ _award-winning work_](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/966a52eede74480384cec52f5af657b1) _in the_[ _Marvelous Designer Creator's Contest 2025 Vol.3 "FANTASY ARCHIVES"_](https://connect.clo-set.com/contest/mdcc2025vol3)_, how she translated her interpretation of steampunk as a "unbalanced mixture of analog and technology" and "fragile dreamy hope" into stunning character designs._

![961ffdaf2a2749c5ab1fa2290de54dc1](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/213d5ede18644a8ebd574b9a5a76bde4/images/961ffdaf2a2749c5ab1fa2290de54dc1image0-1.jpg)[Fly High!](https://connect.clo-set.com/ja/detail/966a52eede74480384cec52f5af657b1)

* * *

**Artist Introduction: please tell us about yourself.**

Hello! I’m [Moon Face Animation](https://www.instagram.com/moonfaceanimation/). Moon face animation is an one (wo)man, animation focused creative studio by Moet. It locates in Montpellier, France and Tokyo, Japan. I have been working in the entertainment & advertisement industry as a 2D&3D creator for about 20 years. I especially love working on concept/visual development and 3D character creation.   
I was really happy to work on this contest because I love thinking about the background story and develop the fashion and the look for the character.

![945928e1b549445e9024cdf24dbd7af5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/213d5ede18644a8ebd574b9a5a76bde4/images/945928e1b549445e9024cdf24dbd7af5image1-1.jpg)

* * *

**Please tell us more about the art direction for your winning entry in the Creator’s Contest 2025 Vol. 3. Specifically, what kind of visual style were you aiming for?**

I did a lot of research for old clothes around Victorian era, and I chose ‘steampunk’ for the core theme. I spent lots time for figuring out what’s the core essence of steampunk. I didn’t want to fall in the typical ‘steampunk-look’ fashion. And my answer for the essence of steampunk was ‘the desire which makes impossible possible’. I wanted to use that core idea for my design.

![32bc569dadd74770867307100263d6c9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/213d5ede18644a8ebd574b9a5a76bde4/images/32bc569dadd74770867307100263d6c9image2-1.jpg)

To me, steampunk has certain kind of ‘unbalanced mixture of analog and technology’ and ‘Fragile dreamy hope’. So I wanted to visualize that feeling into the characters by collage images.

![1b9d80bd5e814846bcd3c00837b9873f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/213d5ede18644a8ebd574b9a5a76bde4/images/1b9d80bd5e814846bcd3c00837b9873fimage2-2.jpg)

For the 3D model creation, I took some photos of some of my clothes and used them as texture for the 3D model. I didn’t know it would work or not, but in the end I really liked the look of it. It didn't look too neat and clean, and it brought hand made and analog feeling of steampunk I aimed for.

![0f2478e5d94541a29c611394e7cd823a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/213d5ede18644a8ebd574b9a5a76bde4/images/0f2478e5d94541a29c611394e7cd823aimage2-3.jpg)

* * *

**Please give us an overview of your asset production pipeline centered on Marvelous Designer. What tools do you use?**  
**Also, tell us about any challenges you faced during production and how you overcame them.**  
I use Maya outside of Marvelous Designer.   
For this project, I made props and base body in Maya. I set poses in Maya and exported as alembic for simulation in Marvelous Designer. The workflow was quite straight forward. This time I used photos for the texture, but I like making own patterns. I’m excited to explore more in the future.

![2db72f1296bd482aa7963181b216cc67](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/213d5ede18644a8ebd574b9a5a76bde4/images/2db72f1296bd482aa7963181b216cc67image3-1.jpg)  
![7d2a13fb37334b0fbbba17c026106bb7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/213d5ede18644a8ebd574b9a5a76bde4/images/7d2a13fb37334b0fbbba17c026106bb7image3-2.jpg)

* * *

**If you have any tips or techniques regarding Marvelous Designer, please share them with the community.**

I like sewing but I’m not a pattern maker. When I started learning Marvelous Designer, I bought several old dress patterns and scanned them and used them as a base pattern for practice. It was really fun exercise for me.

* * *

content_description: Discover the artistic journey of Moet, the creative force behind Moon Face Animation, as she masterfully blends traditional aesthetics with modern 3D technology to craft enchanting character designs inspired by steampunk themes.
